parameters.query:
WITH ins AS (
  INSERT INTO inbox (idempotency_key, source, payload)
  VALUES ($1, $2, $3::jsonb)
  ON CONFLICT (idempotency_key) DO NOTHING
  RETURNING id
)
SELECT (SELECT id FROM ins) AS inserted_id,
       (SELECT id FROM inbox WHERE idempotency_key = $1) AS existing_id
INSERT INTO intake_rejects (reasons, payload) VALUES ($1::jsonb, $2::jsonb) RETURNING id

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ ok: true, duplicate: $json.inserted_id === null, inbox_id: Number($json.inserted_id ?? $json.existing_id) || null }) }}
